latest_news.headline: Iran claims cruise missile attack on USS Abraham Lincoln — Trump says 101 missiles all intercepted
latest_news.source: Iran state media (IRNA/Press TV) + Naval Today + NYT
latest_news.text: Iran's navy released video claiming cruise missile launch at USS Abraham Lincoln carrier group. Trump claims 101 missiles fired, 'every single one intercepted.' CENTCOM denies Lincoln was hit. Iran claims carrier retreated 1,000km. First claimed targeting of US carrier with cruise missiles.

latest_news.headline: Israel strikes Iran's submarine research center in Isfahan — expands war to naval targets
latest_news.text: IDF guided by Israeli navy intelligence struck Iran's Underwater Research Centre in Isfahan — Iran's only submarine design and development facility. Also produced unmanned vessels. Major expansion of target set to naval infrastructure.
